openspec/changes/archive/2026-08-19-harden-studio-promote-contract/design.md:5:Der aktuelle Remote-Config-Vertrag verwendet ein monolithisches GitHub-Secret `APP_CONFIG`. Lokale Werkzeuge führen dagegen ignorierte Dateien wie `base.vars`, Profildateien und `*.local.vars` zusammen. Dadurch konnte eine lokale Override-Datei fälschlich das vollständige Remote-Bundle ersetzen. Die anschließende Production-Recovery zeigte außerdem, dass ein syntaktisch vorhandener IAM-Schlüsselbund fachlich inkompatibel sein kann und dass HTTP-404 während der Traefik-Neubindung nicht durch alle blockierenden Probes einheitlich als Warmup behandelt werden.
tooling/testing/tests/promote-workflow-contract.test.ts:99:      "trap 'rm -f .env config/runtime/base.vars config/runtime/studio.vars' EXIT"
=== promote workflow around base.vars ===
          QUANTUM_ENDPOINT: ${{ vars.QUANTUM_ENDPOINT }}
          SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL: ${{ steps.target.outputs.public_base_url }}
          SVA_STACK_NAME: ${{ steps.target.outputs.stack_name }}
          SVA_ACCEPTANCE_RELEASE_MODE: ${{ inputs.environment }}
          SVA_PROMOTE_PREDEPLOY_ALLOW_IMPLICIT_QUERY_RESPONSE_MODE: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          trap 'rm -f .env config/runtime/base.vars config/runtime/studio.vars' EXIT
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci/render-compose-env.ts --input "${RUNNER_TEMP}/promote-app-config.vars" --output .env
          printf '\nSVA_CONFIG_REVISION=%s\n' "${{ steps.remote_config.outputs.config_revision }}" >> .env
          mkdir -p config/runtime
          cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/promote-app-config.vars" config/runtime/base.vars
          : > config/runtime/studio.vars
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/ops/runtime-env.ts doctor studio

      - name: deploy
        id: deploy
        env:
          QUANTUM_ENDPOINT: ${{ vars.QUANTUM_ENDPOINT }}
          ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
          DEPLOY_IMAGE_REF: ${{ steps.image_contract.outputs.deploy_image_ref }}
          DEPLOY_REVISION: ${{ steps.image_contract.outputs.deploy_revision }}
          CONFIG_REVISION: ${{ steps.remote_config.outputs.config_revision }}
          REDIS_SNAPSHOT_HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REDIS_SNAPSHOT_HMAC_SECRET }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          trap 'rm -f .env stack.json stack.yaml' EXIT

          if [ -z "${QUANTUM_ENDPOINT}" ]; then
            node --experimental-strip-types "${PROMOTE_CONTROLLER_DIR}/scripts/ci/record-promote-failure.ts" PROMOTE_INPUT_INVALID "${ENVIRONMENT}" deploy
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ ! -s "${RUNNER_TEMP}/promote-app-config.vars" ]; then
            node --experimental-strip-types "${PROMOTE_CONTROLLER_DIR}/scripts/ci/record-promote-failure.ts" PROMOTE_CONFIG_REQUIRED_KEY_MISSING "${ENVIRONMENT}" deploy
            exit 1
          fi

          pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci/render-compose-env.ts --input "${RUNNER_TEMP}/promote-app-config.vars" --output .env
          {
            printf '\nIMAGE_REF=%s\n' "${DEPLOY_IMAGE_REF}"
            printf 'SVA_DEPLOY_REVISION=%s\n' "${DEPLOY_REVISION}"
            printf 'SVA_CONFIG_REVISION=%s\n' "${CONFIG_REVISION}"
          } >> .env
          docker compose -f compose.yaml -f "./deploy/compose.${ENVIRONMENT}.yaml" \
            config --no-normalize --format json > stack.json
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci/render-quantum-stack.ts --input stack.json --output stack.yaml

          quantum-cli stacks deploy -f stack.yaml --stack "${{ steps.target.outputs.stack_name }}" --endpoint "${QUANTUM_ENDPOINT}"

      - name: wait for terminal Swarm convergence
        id: swarm_convergence
        env:
          QUANTUM_ENDPOINT: ${{ vars.QUANTUM_ENDPOINT }}
        run: pnpm exec tsx "${PROMOTE_CONTROLLER_DIR}/scripts/ci/verify-swarm-convergence.ts" "${{ inputs.environment }}"

      - name: verify deployed runtime
        id: runtime_smoke
        env:
          QUANTUM_ENDPOINT: ${{ vars.QUANTUM_ENDPOINT }}
          SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL: ${{ steps.target.outputs.public_base_url }}
          SVA_STACK_NAME: ${{ steps.target.outputs.stack_name }}
          SVA_ACCEPTANCE_RELEASE_MODE: ${{ inputs.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          trap 'rm -f .env config/runtime/base.vars config/runtime/studio.vars "${RUNNER_TEMP}/runtime-smoke.stderr"' EXIT
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci/render-compose-env.ts --input "${RUNNER_TEMP}/promote-app-config.vars" --output .env
          printf '\nSVA_CONFIG_REVISION=%s\n' "${{ steps.remote_config.outputs.config_revision }}" >> .env
          mkdir -p config/runtime
          cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/promote-app-config.vars" config/runtime/base.vars
          : > config/runtime/studio.vars
          if ! pnpm exec tsx scripts/ops/runtime-env.ts smoke studio 2>"${RUNNER_TEMP}/runtime-smoke.stderr"; then
            if [ ! -s "${PROMOTE_FAILURE_PATH}" ]; then
              node --experimental-strip-types "${PROMOTE_CONTROLLER_DIR}/scripts/ci/record-promote-failure.ts" PROMOTE_INTERNAL_ERROR "${{ inputs.environment }}" external-smoke
            fi
            exit 1
          fi
